Hi Alyssa — great to hear from you. Happy to confirm and propose an approach that matches what Procurement outlined. High level: we can support split-payor invoicing and a rolling (monthly) invoice cadence tied to usage snapshots for the incremental capacity. Details below: 

Proposed invoicing playbook:
- Base commitment: billed to ForestGrid Inc. as a single annual invoice (prepay or scheduled monthly/quarterly based on your preference).
- Incremental capacity (upsell/overage): billed monthly to ForestGrid Cloud LLC, using a rolling invoice that reflects the previous month's peak units.
- True-ups: quarterly true-up invoice to reconcile consumption vs committed units; credits applied on the following invoice.

POs and payment terms:
- We can accept one PO per entity that references multiple invoice lines. For ease, please include the internal PO number + entity name on each PO PDF. Example PO format we prefer: FG-PO-DF4832-<Entity>-YYYY (we can accept your internal format as long as the entity is explicit).
- Terms: we can offer Net45 for the base commitment for this renewal given the committed ARR increase. Net60 would require an executive exception (we can begin the conversation if Procurement prefers Net60).

Required documents / actions for Procurement:
- Attach ForestGrid_W9 (we have included our W9/EIN as an attachment).
- Upload signed DocuSign order form (link below) — we will countersign on receipt.
- Send invoice routing spreadsheet (contact name, email, billing entity legal name) so we set up the billing account mapping.

DocuSign: https://www.docusign.com/transaction/ABCDEF123456
W9/EIN: attached (ForestGrid_W9.pdf)
Sample invoice (illustrative): attached (sample-invoice-v2.pdf)

Alyssa — quick clarifications from finance side: 

- Proration: for the upgrade we will prorate the base commitment from the renewal effective date to your next billing cycle. Incremental capacity will be measured daily and invoiced monthly with a cap to avoid surprise spikes (we can share the cap rules).
- Billing accounts: we will create two billing accounts in our system (ForestGrid Inc. and ForestGrid Cloud LLC). Each will have its own invoice recipient and remit-to details.
- Payment methods: we support ACH/EFT. If you prefer EFT we will share bank details in a separate secure email once the PO is processed.
